answer: Withdrawal is gated by a time window plus a retroactive proof channel, and the clawback reaches rewards earned inside the window, which means exiting early forfeits not only the bond but the income earned while the bond was still at risk. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. A farm waits out a meadow, risks a tide, and holds a harbor hostage the entire time: it may abandon the harbor to escape, but then the tide still follows it into the next identity it registers. Every short-lived identity forfeits its bond and the rewards earned under it.
